3. The defendant No. 1 (hereinafter called "as the defendant petitioner entered appearance in the suit and on 16-9-2008 filed an application before the learned Joint District judge, 1st Court, Rangpur under Order VII, Rule 11 of the Code of Civil Procedure for rejection of the plaint stating, inter alia, that the plaintiff has instituted the suit for Specific Performance of Contract on the basis of an unregistered bainapatra which is not maintainable as per provisions of section 17(A) of the Registration Act and section 21(A) of the Specific Relief (Amendment) Act and the suit is also barred by limitation. 

 12. It is settled principles of law that the question of limitation in a suit is a mixed question of law and fact which can be decided only at the trial on taking evidence. Therefore, we find no merit in the submission of the learned Advocate for the petitioner.
